SUMMARY.TITLE: Summary
SUMMARY.NO_CLOSED: No closed deals in this period
SUMMARY.NO_WON: No won deals in this period

LOST_REASONS.TITLE: Lost reasons
LOST_REASONS.EMPTY: No lost deals in this period.

WAVE.OWN_TASKS: This report shows your own tasks.

pipeline_by_stage.NAME: Pipeline by stage
pipeline_by_stage.QUESTION: How many open deals, worth how much, sit in each stage?
pipeline_by_stage.DESCRIPTION: Open deals right now, by stage. The weighted value multiplies each deal by its probability.
pipeline_by_stage.EMPTY_HINT: Open deals show here by stage as soon as they are added.

closing.NAME: Closing this period
closing.QUESTION: Which deals must be closed before the period ends?
closing.DESCRIPTION: Open deals whose expected close date falls in the period, soonest first.
closing.EMPTY: No deals expected to close in this period
closing.EMPTY_HINT: Pick another period, or set expected close dates on open deals.

stale.NAME: Stale and late deals
stale.QUESTION: Which deals have stopped moving or passed their close date?
stale.DESCRIPTION: Open deals with no activity for a while, or whose expected close date has passed.
stale.EMPTY_HINT: Every open deal had recent activity and is still on schedule.

my_tasks.NAME: My tasks
my_tasks.QUESTION: What is due from me today, and what is late?
my_tasks.DESCRIPTION: Your overdue and due-today calls, meetings and tasks, and what you finished in the period.
my_tasks.EMPTY_HINT: No overdue or due-today tasks, and none finished in this period.

won_lost.NAME: Wins and losses
won_lost.QUESTION: What closed in the period, and how?
won_lost.DESCRIPTION: Deals won and lost in the period, against the period before.
won_lost.EMPTY: No deals closed in this period
won_lost.EMPTY_HINT: Pick a longer period to see results.

quota.NAME: Target attainment
quota.QUESTION: How much of the target is won, and how much is left?
quota.DESCRIPTION: Value won in the period against the monthly targets set in Sales settings.
quota.EMPTY_HINT: Set monthly targets in Sales settings to track attainment.

forecast.NAME: Sales forecast
forecast.QUESTION: How much will we close by the end of the period?
forecast.DESCRIPTION: Won so far, plus the open deals expected in the period by forecast category, against the target.
forecast.EMPTY: Nothing won or expected in this period
forecast.EMPTY_HINT: Set expected close dates on open deals to build a forecast.

coverage.NAME: Pipeline coverage
coverage.QUESTION: Are the open deals enough to reach the rest of the target?
coverage.DESCRIPTION: Open value expected to close in the period, divided by what is left of the target.
coverage.EMPTY: No target and no open deals in this period
coverage.EMPTY_HINT: Set monthly targets in Sales settings, and expected close dates on open deals.

win_rate.NAME: Win rate
win_rate.QUESTION: From which employee, product or source do we win most?
win_rate.DESCRIPTION: Won ÷ (won + lost) in the period, by count and by value, against the period before.
win_rate.EMPTY: No deals closed in this period
win_rate.EMPTY_HINT: Pick a longer period to compare win rates.

losses.NAME: Lost reasons and competitors
losses.QUESTION: Why do we lose, and to whom?
losses.DESCRIPTION: Deals lost in the period by reason, competitor and the stage they were lost in.
losses.EMPTY: No deals lost in this period

activity.NAME: Team activity
activity.QUESTION: Does each employee’s activity match their results?
activity.DESCRIPTION: Calls, meetings and tasks completed and notes written by each employee, beside what they won.
activity.EMPTY_HINT: Completed tasks and deal notes show here.

new_deals.NAME: New deals by source
new_deals.QUESTION: How many new deals were created, and where did they come from?
new_deals.DESCRIPTION: Deals created in the period by lead source, over time, against the period before.
new_deals.EMPTY: No new deals in this period
new_deals.EMPTY_HINT: Pick a longer period, or add deals.

data_quality.NAME: Data quality
data_quality.QUESTION: Which deals are incomplete or out of date and spoil the reports?
data_quality.DESCRIPTION: Open deals missing a value, a close date or an owner, past their close date, or with no recent activity.
data_quality.EMPTY_HINT: Open deals are checked here as soon as they are added.

scorecard.NAME: Employee scorecard
scorecard.QUESTION: How does each employee do against the team, and where do they need support?
scorecard.DESCRIPTION: Attainment, win rate, coverage, sales cycle and activity, beside the team average.
scorecard.EMPTY: Nothing to score in this period
scorecard.EMPTY_HINT: Set targets, or pick a period with deals.

CLOSING.PARTIAL: Showing {shown} of {total}; click the count to see all

WON_LOST.BAR_HINT: Click a bar to see its deals

FORECAST.GAP: Still missing to reach the target with the forecast:
FORECAST.CATEGORY_HINT: The category picked on the deal, else from its probability (90%+ commit, 50%+ best case)

PRINT.OWN_DEALS: Shows the deals of the employee who printed it only.
PRINT.OWN_TASKS: Shows the tasks of the employee who printed it.

COVERAGE.HOW: Coverage = open value closing in the period ÷ (target − won). Aim for {multiple}× (Sales settings).

WIN_RATE.HINT: Highest win rate first; the count is the closed deals, click it to see them

LOSSES.STAGES_HINT: The stage before it was lost

ACTIVITY.WHAT_COUNTS: Completed tasks by kind, and notes on deals; chats do not count

DATA_QUALITY.COMPLETE_MEANS: Complete = a value, an expected close date and an owner.
DATA_QUALITY.ALL_GOOD: Every open deal is complete and up to date.

SCORECARD.AVERAGE_NOTE: Team average over {count} active employees (with a target or deals in the period).

SETTINGS.TITLE: Sales settings
SETTINGS.SUBTITLE: Pipelines, stages and how your team sees deals.
SETTINGS.CURRENCY_LOCKED: The currency cannot change once deals exist, since amounts are not converted.
SETTINGS.ACTUAL_HINT: Actual: the real win rate of deals that passed the stage in the last 12 months. Shows after {min} closed deals; click it to use it.
SETTINGS.ACTUAL_FROM: From {count} closed deals in the last 12 months
SETTINGS.ACTUAL_NOT_ENOUGH: Not enough data: {count} of {min} closed deals
SETTINGS.USE_ACTUAL: Use the actual rate {rate}% for stage “{name}”
SETTINGS.SEE_OWN_LABEL: Agents see only their own deals
SETTINGS.MOVE_DEALS_BODY: Choose the stage to move its {count} deal(s) to before removing it.
SETTINGS.NEED_WON_LOST: A pipeline needs exactly one Won stage and one Lost stage.
SETTINGS.NEED_OPEN: A pipeline needs at least one open stage.
SETTINGS.DELETE_PIPELINE_CONFIRM: Delete this pipeline? Only empty pipelines can be deleted.
SETTINGS.ADMIN_ONLY: Only administrators can change sales settings.
SETTINGS.LOST_REASONS_HINT: The list agents pick from when a deal is lost. Deals already lost keep their reason.
SETTINGS.CURRENCY_HINT: The currency of every sales deal. It cannot change once the first deal is added.
SETTINGS.STALE_DAYS_HINT: An open deal with no activity for this long counts as stale.
SETTINGS.COVERAGE_HINT: Open pipeline needed compared with the remaining target.

PANEL.TITLE: Deals & tasks
PANEL.NONE: No open deals or tasks for this customer.

HINTS.lead_source: Where the customer came from. Picked on each deal; drives win rate and new deals by source.
HINTS.product: What you sell. Picked on each deal; drives win rate and revenue by product.
HINTS.competitor: Who you compete with for the deal. Shown in the lost reasons analysis.
HINTS.region: The customer's region, for revenue by region.
HINTS.industry: The customer's industry, for revenue by industry.

LISTS.EMPTY: The list is empty. Add the first item.
LISTS.ARCHIVE_HINT: Leaves the list; stays on the deals that have it

TARGETS.TITLE: Monthly targets
TARGETS.HINT: Each employee's target for the month, in {currency}. The team target is their sum. Leave a field empty to clear that employee's month.
